title: CortexSpark Ventures launches Rs 1,000 crore deeptech fund, targets 20 startups
summary: CortexSpark Ventures launches a Rs 1,000 crore deeptech fund targeting 20 startups
detailed: The firm plans to invest in around 20 startups, with an average cheque size of $4-5 million, focusing on companies developing proprietary technologies in six sectors, managing partners Vinay Peshwa and Sanjay Khanduri told ET.
